value.rationale: A natural complete classification of numerical maximum-principle preservation on the entire standard connected strongly regular graph class, with a single graph-combinatorial structural frontier. The result differentiates infinite unconditionally positive Paley families from explicit finite-threshold Petersen and triangular graphs, showing that positive stable eigenvalues and conservation do not imply positivity. Not a generic textbook calculation or unmotivated chosen numeric slice.
